description: This is a Node.js CLI script for linting code snippets extracted from markdown files, supporting multiple languages and reporting metrics.

classes.name: LintingService
classes.description: Base class for code linting services supporting different languages.

classes.name: LintingServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class to manage multiple linting services and report metrics.

methods.name: getAllMarkdownFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects all markdown files in a directory.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function to process markdown files, extract code snippets, and perform linting.

methods.name: _writeTempSnippetsFile
methods.description: Writes code snippets to a temporary JSON file.

methods.name: spawnAsync
methods.description: Spawns a child process to run external linting commands.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a language is supported by the linting service.

methods.name: _lintSnippet
methods.description: Lints a single code snippet using ESLint.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the language is supported by the specific linting service.

methods.name: lint
methods.description: Performs linting for Python, C#, or Java code snippets.

methods.name: lintAndReport
methods.description: Runs linting on all snippets and reports metrics.

methods.name: _collectMetrics
methods.description: Updates metrics for a specific language based on linting results.
